title: The Schoolmaster Who Fell in Love by Report
logline: A learned schoolmaster shuts his school and goes into mourning for a woman he has never seen, because of two lines sung by a passer-by under his window.
moral: Learning is not judgment: do not build love, grief or any big conclusion on hearsay and an untested guess.
tone: Dry, affectionate comedy of manners: a sympathetic set-up, a slow reveal in a sickroom mood, then two absurd leaps of logic shown as thought clouds, and a gentle visual punchline.

beats.summary: A travelling scholar finds a small school and a smartly dressed teacher drilling three children.
Three questions (language, grammar, poetry), three exact answers: the scholar is impressed.
The scholar's old assumption: schoolteachers have the book but not the lamp (learning without judgment). The book and lamp icons are planted for the ending.
On a later visit the school door is shut and locked.
Neighbours: the teacher is at home grieving for someone he lost.
Father? Brother? Relative? The teacher shakes his head at each one.
He grieves for a woman he loves.
He admits he has never once seen her; the scholar is thunderstruck.
Flashback: a passer-by sang under his window about a woman named Umm Amr.
He decided poets only praise great beauty, and fell in love on the spot.
Two days later the same cheerful singer: Umm Amr and her donkey left and did not come back.
The teacher concludes she is dead, shuts the school and puts on mourning.
The song never said she died: GONE is not DEAD.
The scholar leaves more astonished than ever.
Much learning, yet love and grief built on two lines of a song, with no knowledge of the woman or her fate.

sets.description: One street strip used for every exterior: marketStreet {w: 2000, palette:'clear', palace:false, props:[['barrel',180],['crate',1150]]} with three custom fronts (targets, measure on the set): SCHOOL front x 300..700, roof y 430, door x 440..560 top 690 bottom 900 (townDoor), sign board 220 x 70 centred (500, 640); NEIGHBOUR front x 760..1060, door cx 900, upper window centre (840, 560) 120 x 140 with shutters; TEACHER'S HOUSE x 1320..1680, two storeys, roof y 330, door x 1370..1470 top 700, upper window centre (1560, 500) 170 x 190 with a 200 x 18 sill ledge at y 595. Flashbacks use palette 'dusk' / u cycling plus the dream wash.

Planned kuttab dressing of palaceHall {variant:'merchant', wall:'paper', curtain:1, desk:false, treasure:false}: floor y 900; door at the left (anchor door); window pane showing the time of day (u) at about (500, 430); three pupil mats at x 190, 310, 430 (y 925, front row); guest cushion at x 560; teacher's cushion at x 780 with a low book stand at x 860; shelf of spare tablets top right.

The teacher's sitting room: palaceHall {variant:'merchant', wall:'ochre', curtain:1 (closed), desk:false, treasure:false, lampsLit:false}, shelves filled with books instead of jars (bookStack rows), window pane (u 0.3) at about (520, 430) as measured from the anchors, two floor cushions at x 380 and x 640, three book stacks on the floor at x 760..860 (he is learned), one book open face down beside him.

props.description: Planned school tablet (lawh): board 70 x 95 with a handle tab, 4 ink bands; hand size for the pupils, 150 x 200 for the teacher's lesson board on the book stand.
Planned lute: pear body 90 x 120 (yellow, red rose hole), neck 110 bent back at the pegbox, 4 strings; held across the body, right hand strums (handRW oscillates 14 units at 6 Hz while singing).
Speech balloon with a picture inside (callback), smooth oval and a pointed tail to the speaker; holds busts, the row of ladies, the heart, the song picture.

The moral diagram inside the scholar's last thought cloud: two small quaver notes as the foundation, a red heart block (120 wide) on them, a dark grave block (graveMarker, 110 x 150) on the heart; wobbles, then topples.
Planned 'book' prop stacked: each book 110 x 26, alternating red, blue, yellow covers with a paper page edge; n 0..6 pops on one at a time.
Planned grave marker: rounded stone 110 x 150, paper colour with grey dots, low mound; no text.
Door furniture drawn with townDoor options {shut:true, lock:true} plus a hanging CLOSED board 160 x 60 on two cords that swings (swing()).

subtitles.ar: مر عالم ذات يوم بمدرسة صغيرة،|فرأى معلمًا حسن الهيئة يدرس الصغار.|دعاه المعلم إلى الجلوس، فتحدث معه العالم في اللغة والنحو والشعر،|وأعجب بما سمع من أجوبة دقيقة.
subtitles.en: A scholar passed a small school|and met a well-dressed teacher.|He tested him in language, grammar and poetry,|and was impressed by his answers.

subtitles.ar: عاد العالم إلى المدرسة مرات كثيرة،|وكلما تحدث مع المعلم اكتشف معرفة جديدة.|تعجب في نفسه، لأنه كان يظن أن معلمي الأطفال|لا يجمعون دائمًا بين العلم وحسن التفكير.
subtitles.en: The scholar visited repeatedly|and discovered more knowledge each time.|He had assumed that schoolteachers|seldom combined learning with sound judgment.

subtitles.ar: وفي زيارة لاحقة وجد باب المدرسة مغلقًا.|سأله الجيران عن سبب الإغلاق،|فقالوا إن المعلم في بيته حزين على شخص فقده.|ذهب العالم إليه ليواسيه ويعرف ما جرى.
subtitles.en: On a later visit the school was closed.|Neighbors said|the teacher was mourning someone,|so the scholar went to his house to offer sympathy.

subtitles.ar: جلس المعلم وقد ظهرت عليه علامات الحزن.|سأله ضيفه من الذي مات، أهو والده أم أخوه أم أحد أقاربه؟|أجاب المعلم بالنفي،|ثم قال إن حزنه على امرأة يحبها.
subtitles.en: The teacher sat looking miserable.|Asked whether his father, brother or relative had died,|he said no:|he was grieving for a woman he loved.

subtitles.ar: حاول العالم تهدئته، فقال إن في الدنيا نساء كثيرات.|عندئذ اعترف المعلم بأنه لم ير تلك المرأة قط.|ازداد العالم دهشة،|وسأله كيف أحب إنسانة لم يقابلها في حياته.
subtitles.en: The scholar tried to console him,|but the teacher admitted he had never even seen the woman.|The visitor asked|how such love had begun.

subtitles.ar: قال المعلم إنه سمع رجلًا يمر تحت نافذته|وهو يغني عن امرأة اسمها أم عمرو.|ظن أن الشعراء لا يمدحونها إلا لجمالها العظيم،|فتعلق بها من ذلك اليوم.
subtitles.en: The teacher had heard a passerby|sing admiringly of a woman named Umm Amr.|Assuming she must be extraordinarily beautiful,|he fell in love with her.

subtitles.ar: وبعد يومين سمع الرجل نفسه يغني|أن أم عمرو وحمارها رحلا ولم يعودا.|فهم المعلم من الكلمات أنها ماتت، فأغلق المدرسة ولبس ثياب الحزن،|مع أن الأغنية لم تؤكد موتها.
subtitles.en: Two days later the same singer said|Umm Amr and her donkey had gone and not returned.|The teacher took this to mean she was dead,|although the song never said so.

subtitles.ar: خرج العالم من البيت وهو أشد تعجبًا من ذي قبل.|فقد عرف أن الرجل يحفظ علومًا كثيرة،|لكنه بنى حبًا وحزنًا على بيتين من الغناء،|دون أن يعرف حقيقة المرأة أو مصيرها.
subtitles.en: The scholar departed astonished.|The teacher knew many disciplines,|yet had built both a romance and a period of mourning|upon two songs and an untested guess.

new_assets.name: schoolRoom
new_assets.description: Planned kuttab dressing of palaceHall variant 'merchant' (AN-123): three pupil mats (140 x 40 striped ovals), guest cushion and teacher cushion (floorCushion 120 x 36), low X-frame book stand 90 high carrying a 150 x 200 lesson tablet, shelf of 5 spare tablets, inkpot. Positions in sets.schoolRoom.
new_assets.implementation: Call palaceHall({variant:'merchant', wall:'paper', curtain:1, desk:false, shelves:false}) and draw the dressing on top with K shapes in one function schoolRoom(ctx, o) that returns anchors {mats:[x], guest, teacherSeat, stand, window, door}. Bake the static part.

new_assets.name: writingTablet
new_assets.description: Planned lawh (AN-123): board with handle tab and 4 ink bands; s parameter for hand size (70 x 95) and stand size (150 x 200).
new_assets.implementation: Rounded rect in pale wood with black outline, tab on top, 4 wavy ink lines (seeded), optional n lines written 0..4.

new_assets.name: oud
new_assets.description: Planned lute (AN-087 and others): pear body 90 x 120, bent pegbox neck 110, rose hole, 4 strings; drawn across the singer's body at 25 degrees, behind his hands.
new_assets.implementation: Ellipse + tapered quad neck + short angled pegbox; draw before the person's arms (use P.hands for the strum hand, handRW oscillating 14 units at 6 Hz).

new_assets.name: musicNotes
new_assets.description: Planned: n quaver glyphs released from a point, rising on seeded S-paths, rocking and fading; black with yellow or red heads. One variant carries a small picture (the lady) on a large note.
new_assets.implementation: Library note(ctx, x, y, s, col) on paths x0 + sin, y0 - v * age; alpha by age; seeded with K.rng.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: Speech balloon that holds a picture: iconBalloon(ctx, x, y, w, h, t, {p, tail:[x, y], inside(c, t), scale, at}). Same contract as thoughtCloud but a smooth oval with one pointed tail. Sizes used: 260..400 wide, 190..230 high. Close in purpose to the planned answerBalloon; make one function serve both.
new_assets.implementation: Ellipse path + triangular tail, white fill, 7 px black outline, pop with settleTo on p; clip and draw inside() scaled about o.at exactly as thoughtCloud does.

new_assets.name: mysteryFace
new_assets.description: Overlay for a person whose face is unknown: a paper-colour disc (radius = head radius + 2, about 32 at s 1) with a blue Bangers question mark, drawn over the face after the person; headwear and veil stay visible.
new_assets.implementation: After person(ctx, P), draw a disc at the head centre (measure: about y - 196 * s for a standing figure; use the seat from rideOn when riding) and the '?' glyph; optional star glint.

new_assets.name: mourning palette
new_assets.description: Costume palette override for grief: any preset in near-black with grey dots and no jewel (values in cast.teacher.look), plus crooked headwear (rotate the head group 0.08 rad if the figure allows, otherwise shift the turban 4 units).
new_assets.implementation: A constant MOURN_PAL passed as pal; cross-fade from the green palette with mixHex inside turnFlip's squeeze at 144.6.

new_assets.name: songTower
new_assets.description: The moral diagram: two quaver notes (each about 40 high) as feet, a heart block 120 wide on them, a dark graveMarker 110 x 150 on the heart; total height about 330 inside the cloud; sway angle from swing(), topple at 171.6 (heart rolls left, grave falls right, one bounce).
new_assets.implementation: Compose from Library note(), heart() and the planned graveMarker; rotate the group about the notes' base for the sway; for the fall use fallY + impactSquash + rebound per piece with fixed seeds.

new_assets.name: bookStack
new_assets.description: Planned 'book' prop stacked n high (each 110 x 26, red, blue, yellow covers, paper page edge, slight seeded x offsets); also used as shelf rows in teacherRoom and as the single hand book (closed 90 x 26, open 120 x 70).
new_assets.implementation: Rounded rects with a paper strip on one side; n animated with settleTo pops.

new_assets.name: graveMarker

new_assets.implementation: Rect with a semicircular top, mound ellipse, K halftone fill.

new_assets.name: dream wash
new_assets.description: Planned blue halftone corner vignette at strength 0.35 (legendFrame style, no ribbon) marking the told flashback from 107.66 to 150.20.

new_assets.name: goldGlow

new_assets.name: townStreet fronts (school front, two-storey house front)
new_assets.description: Two custom fronts on marketStreet: a school front with a sign board, and a two-storey house with a door and an upper window with a sill ledge that a bust can lean on. Dimensions in sets.townStreet.
new_assets.implementation: Use marketStreet's houses option if it accepts the geometry, otherwise draw with townDoor and townWindow over a flat front; the window bust is a person clipped to the opening (draw wall, clip rect of the opening, person, sill ledge on top).

owner_questions: SCRIPT: the English is a condensed translation of the Arabic (for example P1 omits the invitation to sit, P5 omits 'there are many women in the world', P8 words the last clause differently); both are kept verbatim as supplied.
Umm Amr is never shown in the real world: she appears only inside balloons and thought clouds, always with a question mark disc over her face; default yes, because nobody in the story has seen her.
Added comic business beyond the script: the pupils cheer and skip away when the school is locked (144.0) and play by the school at the end; default kept, about 2 s in total.
Added prop business: the teacher's book falls out of the window when he falls in love (125.2) and the scholar picks it up at the end (152.0); default kept.

Invented lettering (16 items): SCHOOL, 3 / 3, VISIT 4 (counter), LATER..., CLOSED, NO!, MANY!, WHAT?!, HOW?, UMM AMR, 2 DAYS LATER, SOB!, THE SONG: GONE, HIS GUESS: DEAD?, 2 SONGS, THE END; default all kept.

The moral is drawn as a tower of love and grief standing on two song notes that topples after the last word, and the BOOK and LAMP icons stand for learning and judgment; default kept (no extra narration).
Death is shown only as a plain grave marker inside a thought cloud (no body, no funeral); default kept.
The scholar is costumed with the 'physician' preset (white turban, grey beard) and the teacher with the green 'merchant' look; default kept, say if a dedicated 'scholar' preset is preferred.
implementation_notes: Copy Library/template to Animations/AN-149; cues come from timing.json words via w(p, n): every cue in this plan gives the Arabic word and its start time, so look the index up by time.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame so all figures blink; give every figure a gaze target (lookAt / look) in every shot; listeners look at the speaker.

One street strip (townStreet, w 2000) serves S1, S5, S6, S9 to S15; bake it once per palette ('clear', 'cold', 'dusk'); translate by camX. School door cx 500, neighbour door cx 900, teacher's door cx 1420, teacher's upper window centre (1560, 500). These are targets: build the fronts to them and export the anchors.

Window bust: draw the house wall, then clip to the window opening and draw the person standing with feet about 70 units below the sill (feet y 665 for sill y 595 at s 0.95), then the sill ledge on top, so he can lean out (tip) and rest hands on the ledge with handLW/handRW.
Seated figures: sit:1, seat:'floor' on the cushions; shuffles are small hop() arcs with landSquash; the shoulder pat uses handRW at the teacher's shoulder (teacher x - 30, y - 150 * s, measure).
Head shakes: the person has no head-only yaw; use a 6 unit x oscillation of the whole seated figure with gaze flipping left/right (2 to 3 cycles at 3 Hz) and lid 1 for the third one.

Balloons and clouds: keep every figure inside at least about 110 px tall on screen; never cover a face; tails end 20 units above the speaker's headwear. Use thoughtCloud for thoughts (S4, S10, S12, S15) and iconBalloon for speech and song (S5, S7, S8, S11).
Flashback S9 to S13: draw the dream wash in panel space; the teacher wears the GREEN palette until the turnFlip at 144.6; in S7, S8, S14 he wears MOURNING.
LATER card at 43.16 to about 44.7 (the narrator says only the first word 'and on' during it); put the camera cut at its covered midpoint.
Two-day wheel (128.16 to 129.5): animate o.u with kfn from 0.3 to 2.3 (use u mod 1); on the strip place your own sun/moon if skyCycle's arc is off screen at camX 1100.

Sound: only 7 effects, all in the listed pauses or after the last word: pop 4.3, thud 12.3, chime 22.0, pop 85.1, thud 127.35, thud 171.8, chime 172.7; SND master 0.6. No effect for the knocks or the door slam (no pauses there): show them with motion and small impact lines.
Panel-only shake for the recoil at 99.22 (6 px, 0.25 s) and the tower fall at 171.8 (4 px).
Film length: 171.90 + 3.0 = 174.90 s. THE END appears at 172.5 and holds to the end.
warnings: Narration is dense: only five pauses of 0.6 s or more, so effects are few and most comedy must read silently.
Word 'مات' at 73.28 is interpolated (shares its time with the next word); no action is cued to it. Bust cues use 74.02, 75.32, 76.76.
The person figure is front-facing only: the teacher at the window and the singer below cannot face each other in profile, so the link is made with gaze, soundArcs, the note stream and the arrow.
Many pictures-in-balloons: keep them large (figures at least 110 px) and one at a time, or the two-shot scenes will look cluttered on a phone.
The custom fronts on marketStreet (school, two-storey house with a lean-out window) may need drawing by hand from townDoor/townWindow if the houses option cannot express them.
